222-527-5686-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5686-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

240-728-5470-8296.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

883-1957-4050--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7201-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7201-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-6798-7286.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

277-2557-3129-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
2511-6972-7932.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

141-2292-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-2292-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {4}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

677-2034-4217-5211.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
677-2034-4217-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lutri.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Lutri from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
677-2034-4217-5211.notes: You can start the combo instead at step 7 if Lutri is in your graveyard. This changes the mana needed to {6}{W}{U}{B}{R}{R}{G}.

775-1409-2097.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

5470-6188-6791.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
5470-6188-6791.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1792-1825-2821-3400.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to four lands excluding Minamo that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
There is another creature on the battlefield.
1792-1825-2821-3400.description:
Activate Minamo and up to four other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting Ivy.
Cast Treachery by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting a creature other than Ivy.
Ivy triggers, copying the Treachery spell, with the copy targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of the Treachery spell, creating a copy of Treachery attached to Ivy.
When the Treachery token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to four lands excluding Minamo by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ivy.
Resolve the original Treachery spell.
When Treachery enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Ivy by tapping it, returning the nontoken Treachery from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Minamo and up to four other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-3240-4871-6560.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

1399-1606-4452-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
1399-1606-4452-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

38-659-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-4885.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

4944-5519--21.description:
Activate the equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Bladegraft Aspirant.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the equipment's ability, attaching it to Bladegraft Aspirant.
Repeat.

586-2511-5626-6112.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

722-3153-5400.notablePrerequisites: Synth Infiltrator is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-3153-5400.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-3651-5256-5615.notablePrerequisites: The Master does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3651-5256-5615.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aphetto Vulture.
When Aphetto Vulture dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill Aphetto Vulture from your library.
Activate The Master by tapping it, putting Aphetto Vulture from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aphetto Vulture enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2232-2837-4336-5270.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Samwise Gamgee's first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

376-678-1796-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional non-Human creature.
Centaur Omenreader is tapped.
376-678-1796-4050.description:
Cast Cubwarden for its mutate cost by paying {W}{W}, targeting a non-Human creature you control.
The Cubwarden mutated creature triggers, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cubwarden mutated creature, adding {W}.
When the Cubwarden mutated creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Cubwarden and any cards merged with it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Cat token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

372-3908-4284.description:
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Spark Double leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Clone returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Spark Double.
When Clone enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Spark Double until Clone leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Spark Double leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Clone until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Clone leaves the battlefield, Spark Double returns to the battlefield from exile as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-3166-4840.notablePrerequisites:
You do not have the highest life total, or are tied for the highest life total.
Myr Battlesphere does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four other artifacts.
1558-3166-4840.description:
Declare Myr Battlesphere as an attacker, attacking the opponent with the most life or tied for the most life.
Myr Battlesphere's dethrone ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and four other artifacts you control.
When Myr Battlesphere dies, Marchesa's second ability triggers, causing you to return Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield at the beginning of your end step.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Marchesa triggers, causing you to return Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Repeat each turn.

4067-5162.description:
Activate Kwain by tapping it, allowing each player to draw a card and gain 1 life if they draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kwain.
Repeat.
